title: 第1章 武道生异能生第2章 有人欢喜有人忧
content_zh:
“王生，快醒醒，不然就错过异能觉醒仪式了。”
趴在桌上睡觉的王生悠悠转醒，意识朦胧间，忽的多出了许多疑问。
异能觉醒仪式？
我没参加什么中二病社团啊。
再说都初三了，中二病跟我有个集贸关系？
想着，王生终于是起身伸了个懒腰，旋即看到同桌女生的陌生面孔。
“刘盈婉，早啊。”
他脱口而出喊了眼前漂亮女生的名字。
咦，自己是怎么知道她叫刘盈婉的？
霎时，无数记忆碎片浮现脑海，王生瞬间捋清楚了现在的情况：他穿越了。
或者与其说是穿越，更像是觉醒了前世记忆。
好！不用参加中考了。
不对！中等武道考试又是什么鬼？
回忆起此世经历，他顿时又感到一阵惆怅，心绪也跟着复杂起来。
自数百年前世界出现“源界裂隙”之后，伴随着各种灾害而来的，还有一种名为“源质”的东西。
源质无形无色，却会自行激发生物的基因潜能，人们凭此获得武道伟力，勉强拥有了抵御天灾入侵的战力。
因此，在生存压力面前，蓝星早已变得全民尚武，武道学生们卷修炼比上辈子卷刷题还要更离谱。
而除了武道之外。
还有一种相对稀有的新能力在近几十年来逐渐被人发掘与掌握......
“还迷糊呢？赶紧起来吧。”

王生只觉肩头传来一阵巨力。
刘盈婉那葱白玉指就如铁钳般将他拎了起来。
好强的力道！
刘盈婉是不是快入境了？
要知道入境是保送青江一中的门槛，那可是整个青江市最好的高中。
看来刘盈婉进入青江一中是板上钉钉的事了。
“王生，你昨晚是不是又熬夜修炼了？这样会越练越虚的，别太拼了，再说了，不是还有异能这条路吗？”
见王生还在发呆，刘盈婉又催促道：
“好了，快走吧，今天这么重要的日子都差点错过，还好你同桌我有责任心，不然你就等着留级，明年再觉醒吧。”
她一边娇嗔道，一边拉着王生往外走。
此刻的教室里没有人，随着王生被扯到班级门口，他余光也看清了班级牌：
异能生特训班。
与寻常的武道班不一样，这是专为异能生打造的班级。
异能生表面上看去和武道生并无不同，大家都同样能修炼成为武者，吃一样的，练一样的。
但异能生却有一点特殊之处，那就是可以通过外力刺激手段，额外觉醒特异能力，是区别于武道之外的力量。
当然了，本质上异能的来源也是源质，只是在人体里分化出了与武道不一样的路线。
而拥有觉醒异能潜质的武道生被称作异能生，是学校里的少数派，每个年级也就勉强能凑够一个班级。
“异能么......不知道我会觉醒什么。”
王生心里不由期待。
毕竟他武道资质平平，想考上武道高中很难。
content_en:
"Wang Sheng, wake up quickly, or you will miss the power awakening ceremony."
Wang Sheng, who was sleeping on the table, suddenly woke up and suddenly had many questions in his hazy consciousness.
Power awakening ceremony?
I haven't joined any chuunibyou club.
Besides, it’s already the third year of junior high school. Does the second-grade disease have a trading relationship with me?
Thinking about it, Wang Sheng finally stood up and stretched, and immediately saw the unfamiliar face of the girl at the same table.
"Liu Yingwan, morning."
He blurted out the name of the beautiful girl in front of him.
Hey, how did I know her name was Liu Yingwan?
Suddenly, countless memory fragments appeared in his mind, and Wang Sheng instantly understood the current situation: he had traveled through time.
Or rather than traveling through time, it's more like awakening memories of past lives.
good! No need to take the high school entrance examination.
wrong! What the hell is the intermediate martial arts exam?
Recalling his experiences in this life, he suddenly felt melancholy again, and his mood became complicated.
Since the "Origin Rift" appeared in the world hundreds of years ago, along with various disasters, there was also something called "Origin".
The source of essence is invisible and colorless, but it will stimulate the genetic potential of living things on its own. People gain martial arts power through this, and barely have the fighting power to resist the invasion of natural disasters.
Therefore, in the face of the pressure of survival, Blue Star has already become a martial arts community, and the martial arts students' practice exams are even more outrageous than the exam exams they took in their previous lives.
And besides martial arts.
There is also a relatively rare new ability that has been gradually discovered and mastered in recent decades...
"Still confused? Get up quickly."
Wang Sheng felt a huge force coming from his shoulders.
Liu Yingwan's green-white jade fingers lifted him up like iron pliers.
What a strong force!
Is Liu Yingwan entering the country soon?
You must know that entry is the threshold for admission to Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School, which is the best high school in the entire Qingjiang City.
It seems that Liu Yingwan's admission into Qingjiang No. 1 Middle School is a sure thing.
"Wang Sheng, did you stay up late to practice again last night? You will become weaker as you practice, so don't work too hard. Besides, isn't there a way to gain superpowers?"
Seeing that Wang Sheng was still in a daze, Liu Yingwan urged again:
"Okay, let's go. I almost missed such an important day today. Fortunately, I am a responsible person at your desk. Otherwise, you would have waited to repeat the grade and wake up next year."
She said coquettishly while pulling Wang Sheng out.
There was no one in the classroom at the moment. As Wang Sheng was dragged to the door of the class, he could see the class sign clearly from the corner of his eye:
Special training class for students with special abilities.
Unlike ordinary martial arts classes, this is a class specially created for students with special abilities.
On the surface, supernatural students are no different from martial arts students. Everyone can train to become a warrior, eat the same food, and practice the same way.
However, there is something special about students with special abilities, that is, they can awaken additional special abilities through external stimulation, which is a power that is different from martial arts.
Of course, in essence, the source of supernatural powers is also the source of essence, but it has differentiated into a different route in the human body than martial arts.
Martial arts students with the potential to awaken superpowers are called superstudents, and they are a minority in the school. Each grade can barely make up one class.
"Super powers... I don't know what I will awaken."
Wang Sheng couldn't help but look forward to it.
After all, his martial arts qualifications were mediocre and it would be difficult for him to get into a martial arts high school.
